title: Complaints about digital platforms surge
desc: The Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA) has reported a decline of more than 14% in overall online complaints during the first eight months of 2026, but warned that complaints involving digital platform services have surged.
title_cn: 数字平台投诉量激增
summary_cn: 泰国电子交易发展局（ETDA）报告显示，2026 年前八个月整体在线投诉下降超 14%，但针对数字平台服务的投诉却大幅增加。该机构对数字平台服务相关投诉的激增趋势发出警告。
desc_original: The Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA) has reported a decline of more than 14% in overall online complaints during the first eight months of 2026, but warned that complaints involving digital platform services have surged.

title: Klong Toey oil residue 'stable'
desc: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday that oil residue in drainage pipes in Klong Toey district had not increased significantly, while authorities worked to identify its source.
title_cn: 隆提区油污「稳定」
summary_cn: 曼谷市长差查特（Chadchart Sittipunt）周一表示，隆提区（Klong Toey）排水管道中的油污未见显著增加，当局正在进行调查以确定污染源。
desc_original: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday that oil residue in drainage pipes in Klong Toey district had not increased significantly, while authorities worked to identify its source.

title: Senator calls for tighter control over temple finances
desc: A senator on Monday urged tighter financial controls and oversight of monks after more than 92 million baht was allegedly embezzled from an Ayutthaya temple.
title_cn: 参议员呼吁加强寺院财务管控
summary_cn: 泰国参议员周一呼吁加强对僧侣的财务控制与监督，原因是大城府（Ayutthaya）一座寺院遭曝涉嫌挪用超 9200 万泰铢资金。此案引发对宗教机构财务透明度的关注。
desc_original: A senator on Monday urged tighter financial controls and oversight of monks after more than 92 million baht was allegedly embezzled from an Ayutthaya temple.

title: Thailand third in Asean digital development
desc: Thailand ranks third in Asean for digital development, with gains in infrastructure and data governance offset by a decline in innovation, according to GSMA Intelligence's Digital Nations 2026 report.
title_cn: 泰国东盟数字发展排名第三
summary_cn: 根据GSMA Intelligence《2026数字国家报告》，泰国在东盟地区数字发展排名第三。基础设施和数据治理方面取得进展，但创新能力有所下滑。这反映了泰国在数字转型过程中的阶段性成果与挑战。
desc_original: Thailand ranks third in Asean for digital development, with gains in infrastructure and data governance offset by a decline in innovation, according to GSMA Intelligence's Digital Nations 2026 report.

title: Government moves against Thaicom over satellite assets
desc: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (DES) has officially initiated arbitration proceedings against Thaicom Plc, seeking more than 1 billion baht in compensation for the alleged incomplete handover of satellite assets to the ministry after the end of its satellite concession.
title_cn: 政府启动仲裁控告泰国国家通信卫星公司卫星资产争议
summary_cn: 数字经济与社会发展部对泰国国家通信卫星公司（Thaicom Plc）启动仲裁程序，索赔逾10亿泰铢。争议源于卫星特许经营权到期后，Thaicom未完整交付卫星资产。此案涉及政府资产管理和企业责任问题。
desc_original: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (DES) has officially initiated arbitration proceedings against Thaicom Plc, seeking more than 1 billion baht in compensation for the alleged incomplete handover of satellite assets to the ministry after the end of its satellite concession.

title: New oil price spike threatens high season
desc: After oil prices surged again following Saudi Arabia's closure of pipelines that bypass the Strait of Hormuz, the disruption could affect the upcoming high season to some extent, particularly as short-haul travellers may postpone or reconsider their trips. Bookings from long-haul markets, however, remain strong.
title_cn: 油价飙升威胁泰国旅游旺季
summary_cn: 沙特关闭绕过荷莫兹海峡管道后，国际油价再次上升，可能冲击泰国即将到来的旅游旺季。短程旅客可能延迟或改变行程，长程市场预订则相对稳定。燃油成本上升对航空运输和旅游产业构成压力。
desc_original: After oil prices surged again following Saudi Arabia's closure of pipelines that bypass the Strait of Hormuz, the disruption could affect the upcoming high season to some extent, particularly as short-haul travellers may postpone or reconsider their trips. Bookings from long-haul markets, however, remain strong.

title: Nestlé vows to fight legal case to the end
desc: The legal battle between the Mahagitsiri family and Nestlé continues, with Nestlé vowing to fight the case to the end.
title_cn: 雀巢誓言将商业诉讼战打到底
summary_cn: 玛哈吉西里家族与雀巢之间的法律纠纷仍在进行中，雀巢表示将坚决应诉。这场长期争讼涉及商业权益和资产权属问题，备受泰国商界关注。案件进展将对双方商业利益产生重要影响。
desc_original: The legal battle between the Mahagitsiri family and Nestlé continues, with Nestlé vowing to fight the case to the end.

title: Crackdown on large companies delaying SME payments
desc: The Commerce Ministry is to issue an announcement by the Trade Competition Commission (TCC) prohibiting large businesses from unreasonably delaying payments for goods purchased from small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
title_cn: 商务部严查大企业拖欠中小企业货款
summary_cn: 泰国商务部将通过贸易竞争委员会发布公告，禁止大型企业无理由延迟支付中小企业供应的商品款项。此举旨在保护中小企业利益，规范商业竞争秩序。对在泰投资的外商和本地企业均有约束力。
desc_original: The Commerce Ministry is to issue an announcement by the Trade Competition Commission (TCC) prohibiting large businesses from unreasonably delaying payments for goods purchased from small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

title: Energy security now global priority
desc: Energy security has become a shared priority for every nation, with natural gas central to efforts to secure sufficient energy supplies as well as support the transition to a low-carbon economy, said Energy Minister Akanat Promphan at Gastech 2026.
title_cn: 能源安全成全球优先事项
summary_cn: 泰国能源部长阿卡纳·普罗姆潘在Gastech 2026国际会议上表示，能源安全已成为全球各国的共同优先事项。面对全球能源需求和气候变化挑战，天然气作为清洁能源，对既能保障充足能源供应、又能支持向低碳经济转型具有战略意义。国际社会需加强能源领域合作。
desc_original: Energy security has become a shared priority for every nation, with natural gas central to efforts to secure sufficient energy supplies as well as support the transition to a low-carbon economy, said Energy Minister Akanat Promphan at Gastech 2026.

title: Somchart seeks further delay
desc: People's Party (PP) Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has postponed giving testimony to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) for a third time in a probe into the alleged use of nominees to hold property for foreign nationals in Phuket.
title_cn: 普吉岛议员因房产代持案第三次延迟作证
summary_cn: 泰国人民党普吉岛国会议员颂察·德查他翁察仑因涉嫌利用代理人代持外国人在普吉岛房产一案，第三次推迟向特别调查部门作证。该案关系到泰国对外国人违规购置本地房产的执法工作。根据泰国法律，外国人直接购房受到严格限制，此案反映政府加强房地产市场监管的决心。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has postponed giving testimony to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) for a third time in a probe into the alleged use of nominees to hold property for foreign nationals in Phuket.

title: Cooperation 'key' to resilience
desc: Asean must make better use of its combined market, deepen economic integration and ensure that smaller businesses share in regional growth if it is to remain competitive amid geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruption, business leaders told the 2026 World Knowledge Forum (WKF).
title_cn: 合作是东盟保持竞争力的关键
summary_cn: 参加2026年世界知识论坛的亚洲商界领袖认为，东盟要在复杂的地缘政治环境下保持竞争力，关键在于加强内部合作。东盟应更好利用共同市场优势、深化经济一体化进程，特别要确保中小企业分享区域增长机遇。通过联动合作，东盟能更好应对供应链风险，提升整体经济韧性。
desc_original: Asean must make better use of its combined market, deepen economic integration and ensure that smaller businesses share in regional growth if it is to remain competitive amid geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruption, business leaders told the 2026 World Knowledge Forum (WKF).

title: MoU signed to boost semiconductor job openings
desc: The government on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to develop human resources for the semiconductor industry, targeting the training of 10,000 highly skilled manufacturing workers over five years.
title_cn: 泰国启动半导体产业人才培养计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府与产业界签署谅解备忘录，共同推进半导体行业人力资源开发。该计划在未来五年内培训10,000名高技能制造业工人，为泰国芯片产业链发展提供人才支撑。这是泰国优化产业结构、发展高新技术产业的重要举措，有助于吸引国际芯片制造商在泰投资，提升泰国在全球半导体产业中的地位。
desc_original: The government on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to develop human resources for the semiconductor industry, targeting the training of 10,000 highly skilled manufacturing workers over five years.

title: Thailand moves to end 'world waste bin' image
desc: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin on Monday led a search operation targeting an illegal waste disposal network at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri, vowing to end Thailand's reputation as the world's waste bin.
title_cn: 泰国打击非法废物改变「世界垃圾桶」形象
summary_cn: 泰国自然资源和环保部长苏查·朱木林在尖竹汶府林查邦港主持搜查行动，打击非法废物处置网络。泰国长期面临国外非法倾废问题，严重污染环境，损害国际声誉。部长誓言改变泰国「世界垃圾桶」的国际形象，加强监管执法，遏制非法废物进口和处理。此举反映泰国对环保和国家形象的重视。
desc_original: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin on Monday led a search operation targeting an illegal waste disposal network at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri, vowing to end Thailand's reputation as the world's waste bin.

title: BMA clarifies Jewish site role
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has clarified that its authority over a proposed Jewish Association of Thailand building in Sukhumvit Soi 22 is limited to building control, while permits for cemeteries or crematoria require applicants to have lawful rights over the land.

summary_cn: 曼谷市政府(BMA)澄清，其对素坤逸路(Sukhumvit)22巷犹太协会拟建建筑的权限仅限于建筑管制，墓园或火葬场许可需申请人对该地块具有合法权利。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has clarified that its authority over a proposed Jewish Association of Thailand building in Sukhumvit Soi 22 is limited to building control, while permits for cemeteries or crematoria require applicants to have lawful rights over the land.

title: SEC clarifies asset manager's power to sell hotel assets
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has confirmed that One Asset Management (ONEAM) has the legal authority to sell assets under Grand Royal Orchid Hospitality Real Estate Investment Trust (GROREIT) to third parties if the original owner fails to complete a buyback agreement.

summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会(SEC)确认，One资产管理公司(ONEAM)有法律权限向第三方出售大皇家兰花酒店房地产投资信托(GROREIT)下的资产，若原业主未能完成回购协议。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has confirmed that One Asset Management (ONEAM) has the legal authority to sell assets under Grand Royal Orchid Hospitality Real Estate Investment Trust (GROREIT) to third parties if the original owner fails to complete a buyback agreement.

title: Thailand seeks a 'true partner' role within Brics
desc: NEW DELHI: Thailand is seeking to position itself as a "true partner" of Brics, using the grouping to deepen cooperation, diversify markets and pursue new opportunities across the Global South, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.
title_cn: 泰国寻求在金砖国家组织中成为「真正伙伴」
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨克·邦基恐(Sihasak Phuangketkeow)在新德里表示，泰国寻求成为金砖国家组织「真正伙伴」，利用该组织深化合作、开拓市场、在全球南方追求新机遇。
desc_original: NEW DELHI: Thailand is seeking to position itself as a "true partner" of Brics, using the grouping to deepen cooperation, diversify markets and pursue new opportunities across the Global South, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

title: Customs nets B4bn from online tax levies
desc: The Customs Department has collected more than 4 billion baht in import duties and value-added tax (VAT) on foreign online purchases since the government began taxing imported goods from the first baht on Jan 1, exceeding its initial target.
title_cn: 海关网络税征收突破40亿铢
summary_cn: 泰国海关自1月1日政府开始对进口商品全额征税以来，已征收超40亿铢进口关税和增值税(VAT)，超过初期目标。
desc_original: The Customs Department has collected more than 4 billion baht in import duties and value-added tax (VAT) on foreign online purchases since the government began taxing imported goods from the first baht on Jan 1, exceeding its initial target.

title: Anutin pitches Thailand as energy investment hub
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pitched Thailand as a regional hub for energy investment and innovation, citing its strategic location, industrial base and infrastructure as global markets face volatility and rapidly rising power demand.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷推介泰国为能源投资中心
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔(Anutin Charnvirakul)推介泰国作为能源投资和创新区域中心，强调其战略位置、工业基础和基础设施在全球市场波动和电力需求快速增长背景下的竞争优势。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pitched Thailand as a regional hub for energy investment and innovation, citing its strategic location, industrial base and infrastructure as global markets face volatility and rapidly rising power demand.

title: Thailand’s new visa rules start today: Full guide for tourists and expats
desc: Thailand’s new visa rules start today: Full guide for tourists and expats Legacy Thailand ends its 60-day visa exemption on September 15, replacing it with 30-day and 15-day schemes, a shorter Visa on Arrival list and tighter limits at land borders. Thailand’s revised tourist entry rules take effect today, September 15, 2026, changing how long millions of foreign visitors can stay without arranging a visa before departure. The previous 60-day visa exemption for 93 countries and territories has ended. Under the new system, 60 nationalities and territories receive a 30-day exemption, Mauritius and Seychelles receive 15 days, and only Azerbaijan, Belarus and Serbia remain eligible for Visa on Arrival. The change is based on Ministry of Interior announcements published in the Royal Gazette on August 31. It applies according to the date a traveller enters Thailand, not the date a flight or hotel was booked. For tourists, the central question is now which entry route applies to their passport. title: 泰国“串票案”重大进展：77人遭起诉，阿努廷等政坛高层过关
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国的政治悬疑剧，在延迟了近一小时的新闻发布会后拉下帷幕，却也推开了更大风暴的大门。2026年9月14日，泰国选举委员会（选委会）在经过长达数月的独立审议与内部撕扯后，正式对外公布了2024年参议员“串票案”的最终处理决定。面对厚达7.57万页的调查卷宗与427名被投诉人，选委会做出了裁决：将77名涉案人员正式提交最高法院起诉，其中包括26名现任参议员。 然而，这绝非一次彻底的政治清洗——包括现任总理阿努廷、政坛幕后操盘手陈乃温在内的所有政党高层与现任国会议员，均在本次起诉名单中安全过关。 这场跨越两年、触及宪政体制与政坛格局的操纵选举风暴，正在从行政调查迈入终极司法决战。 裁决的“手术刀”：谁被切除，谁被放 行？ 选委会主席纳隆与代理秘书长帕萨功当天在武装警卫的戒备下出席新闻发布会。曼谷警务部门甚至提前调派了约200名防暴警力，在选委会办公大楼周边筑起防线。 选委会将案情涉及的7项法律指控进行了精确切割，呈现出截然不同的命运走向：  – 重罪落地（第四至第七项指控）：这是整起案件的核心。指控涉及通过提供或索取现金、财物、利益输送，以及安排宴请等方式，“买断”候选人选票。选委会认定证据确凿，决定将77名涉案人员全面移送最高法院。  – 轻罪兼理（第三项指控）：针对自我介绍与竞选方式违规，选委会决定起诉36人（这36人已被重叠包含在77的总名单中）。 – 切割政党（第一与第二项指控）：第一项指控聚焦于“政党高层、政客及地方行政人员是否协助候选人当选”（21人涉案）；第二项指控聚焦于“候选人是否接受了政党高层的协助”（140人涉案，含137名现任参议员）。选委会决定对这两项指控全部不予起诉。 最终被移送最高法院的77人结构如下： 26名：现任参议员 36名：拥有参议员选举权的人员 15名：幕后相关人员 候补参议员、国会议员及政党执委无一人被起诉。 “蓝色阵营”解套：总理阿努廷与陈乃温如何全身而退？ 整起案件最受政治观察家瞩目的焦点，无疑是泰自豪党及其党魁、现任总理阿努廷。 2024年6月的参议员选举摒弃了全民直选，首次采用了极度复杂的“行业互选与跨组打分制”。然而，最终当选的200名参议员中，有超过150人被外界划为政治立场高度一致的“蓝色参议员”——蓝色，正是泰自豪党的代表色。  此前，民团组织与特别案件调查厅（DSI）的调查曾指出：泰自豪党大本营武里南府等地存在庞大的组织化网络。调查人员怀疑，时任内政部长的阿努廷利用了地方行政资源，而幕后大佬陈乃温则在暗中协调后勤、安排酒店住宿并分发“统一投票名单”。选委会下属的第26号中央调查委员会曾一度建议追究包括阿努廷、陈乃温在内的229人责任。 但为何最终裁定却将其彻底排除？ 根据代理秘书长帕萨功的说法，选委会内部曾出现严重分歧：第2

title: Family doubts cause of young soldier’s death at Nakhon Ratchasima army camp
desc: Family doubts cause of young soldier’s death at Nakhon Ratchasima army camp Legacy The family of a 20 year old soldier found hanging behind his army unit in Nakhon Ratchasima is calling for further investigation after they questioned the initial conclusion surrounding his death. Private Thitikorn Pongwankham, also known as Nam, served with the 3rd Medical Battalion at Surathampithak Camp in Mueang district. His body was discovered on Saturday, September 12, hanging from a tree behind the coffee shop used by his unit. The 2nd Army Area reported that a soldier from the 23rd Artillery Battalion, which is based at the same camp, was the first to find Thitikorn’s body. According to the army, Thitikorn had been granted leave from September 1 to 10 to return to his home in Na Chaluai district, Ubon Ratchathani. He did not return to the camp after his leave ended. Photo via MGR Online The army subsequently informed his family that he was missing. His relatives searched for him but were unable to locate him or find any trace of his whereabouts before his body was discovered at the camp. The army said commanders and fellow soldiers were questioned as part of the initial investigation.

title: 林查班港口揪出“洋垃圾”，6柜铝废料混入电子垃圾
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 9月14日，泰国自然资源与环境部联合特别案件调查厅、海关、工业厅及相关机构，在春武里府林查班港开展跨境废物专项检查，对9个可疑集装箱进行查验，发现其中来自美国的6个集装箱虽申报为铝废料，但均被发现混有电子垃圾（e-waste）。目前，官方已锁定7家美国出口企业及16家泰国进口企业，将回溯调查过去2年的相关记录，进一步追查整个涉案网络。 泰国自然资源与环境部长素察在林查班港海关办公室表示，根据总理兼内政部长阿努廷关于加强环境保护及保障民众健康的政策，自然资源与环境部正加大力度打击非法进口及倾倒境外废物的行为。 此次行动由自然资源与环境部联合特别案件调查厅、海关、工业厅、联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室、生态修复基金会、犯罪受害者援助协会以及相关机构共同开展，重点检查可能涉嫌非法进口危险废物或违禁商品的可疑集装箱。 此次检查共涉及9个集装箱。其中，来自波兰、英国和新西兰的3个集装箱申报信息与实际货物相符，且未发现污染问题；另外6个来自美国的集装箱均申报为铝废料，但经检查发现全部存在电子垃圾混入情况。 泰国污染控制厅作为自然资源与环境部负责相关技术工作的主要部门，同时也是泰国《巴塞尔公约》协调中心，派员参与“Operation Can Opener”专项行动，并与巴塞尔行动网络合作，对跨境废物运输进行检查和评估，进一步确认相关货物是否属于危险废物或违禁商品。 自然资源与环境部表示，此次行动并非只针对港口末端的货物查扣，而是将进一步追查整个运输及进口链条。目前初步掌握7家来自美国的出口企业及16家泰国进口企业，相关部门将回溯调查过去2年的业务及运输资料，收集证据并追查其他可能涉案人员，一旦确认存在违法行为，将依法严厉追究责任。 素察表示，泰国政府立场明确，绝不允许泰国成为外国危险废物的接收地，也不会让非法废物进口网络利用泰国作为中转地或最终处理场所，因为相关环境及健康成本最终将由泰国民众承担。 近年来，自然资源与环境部已推动多项预防措施，包括禁止进口电子垃圾、塑料废物及城市垃圾，同时强化相关货物的检查和法律执行，以堵塞非法进口废物的漏洞。 9月7日，自然资源与环境部还签署命令，成立专门工作组及特别行动小组，负责跟踪、检查、监控、预防和打击泰国东部地区多个府的非法废物倾倒及污染问题，以提高执法效率并及时应对相关情况。 素察指出，此次直接进入林查班港开展检查，就是为了从源头拦截问题货物，而不是等废物进入泰国境内后再处理。后续调查将覆盖出口商、进口商、港口通关、货物运输以及最终处置等各个环节。一旦发现非法走私行为，将继续追查源头，并依法处理所有相关人员。 此次检查结果及相关技术资料将移交特别案件调查厅、海关及工业厅，作为后续案件调查和司法处理的依据。如果最终确认相关货物属于违反《巴塞尔公约》的非法跨境危险废物运输，污染控制厅将协调《巴塞尔公约

title: Abbot’s 2 billion baht donation is donors’ money, says scholar
desc: Abbot’s 2 billion baht donation is donors’ money, says scholar Legacy A Buddhist scholar clarified the source of the money at 2 billion baht that the abbot had donated to build a new hospital and medical facility in the Don Mueang district of Bangkok. A Facebook page focusing on reports about monastic ranks posted yesterday, September 13, that Phra Phrom Wachira Khunathan, also known as Luang Pho Nen, had donated 2 billion baht towards the construction of a medical facility in Don Mueang. The project is Somdet Phra Maha Ratchamangalacharn Hospital, a Bangkok Metropolitan Administration hospital being developed on 28,800 square metres of land within Pak Nam Temple. The second phase of the project has a budget of 1,999,960,000 baht for 2026 to 2030. It includes a 13-storey, 200-bed hospital, a support building and a staff dormitory. The facility is intended to serve people in Chatuchak, Bang Sue, Lak Si, Don Mueang and Bang Khen areas of Bangkok. Photo via Facebook/ พัดยศ สมณศักดิ์พระสงฆ์ไทย The reported donation is not the first hospital-related project to receive support associated with Luang Pho Nen. Previous projects listed in the source include Ratchapiphat Hospital

title: Airport Rail Link gets four-month extension without subsidy
desc: Airport Rail Link gets four-month extension without subsidy Legacy The Airport Rail Link will continue operating under CP-linked Asia Era One for another four months until January 31, 2027 , before a State Railway of Thailand (SRT) subsidiary takes over the service , Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn confirmed today, September 14. Phiphat, who is also the deputy prime minister, stressed that the arrangement is not a one-year extension and said Asia Era One will not receive a previously discussed operating payment of 60 million baht per month during the four-month transition. Instead, the company will keep the fare revenue it earns and bear the financial risk if the service operates at a loss. After January 31, SRT Electrified Train Company, the railway authority’s subsidiary, is expected to take over operations immediately. Phiphat said there would be no further extension for the private operator. Before the handover, the SRT will inspect the trains, tracks and other assets to ensure they are in suitable condition before its subsidiary assumes responsibility for the line. The latest announcement ends uncertainty surrounding the future of the Airport Rail Link after Asia E

title: 曼谷43家数据中心被查！官方下令暂缓新项目审批
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 近日，曼谷市政府加大对数据中心的安全监管力度，目前已完成对全市数据中心的初步摸排，并针对建筑安全、资源使用、环境影响、消防安全及应急疏散等5大领域制定检查标准。同时，曼谷市政府已暂缓新数据中心项目相关许可证的审批，等待相关政策委员会进一步明确相关定义及执行标准。 9月14日，曼谷市长查察主持召开新闻发布会，公布曼谷市内数据中心检查工作的最新进展。查察表示，目前曼谷共有43家位于普通建筑物内的数据中心，主要分布在办公楼、银行及政府机构等场所，其中大多数规模较小，用电量不超过2兆瓦，且已运营多年。 此外，曼谷还有6家独立式数据中心，其中3家已经投入运营，另外3家仍处于建设阶段。目前，曼谷市政府已暂缓审查这3个在建项目的相关许可证。 在燃油储存方面，43家数据中心中有31家使用小型发电机，因储油量未达到相关标准，无需申请燃油储存许可证；另有12家数据中心的燃油储存量超过1.5万升，均已依法向能源部门申请相关许可证。 查察指出，曼谷的数据中心目前并不属于用电规模达到200至300兆瓦的超大规模数据中心。现阶段，曼谷所有数据中心的用电量合计占全市最高用电量的比例不到3%，用水量也低于大型购物中心。 在监管方面，曼谷市政府主要依据建筑施工及改建许可证、城市规划法规和公共卫生相关法律开展监管，同时与曼谷电力局、曼谷供水局、能源厅、工业厅及自然资源与环境政策规划办公室等相关机构合作，强化数据中心的综合监管。 为进一步保障周边居民及环境安全，曼谷市政府已制定5大领域检查清单，将持续对数据中心进行随机检查。 检查内容包括建筑物是否符合相关国际标准；燃油储存及水电使用是否符合有关部门规定；是否存在水污染、空气污染、健康风险、热影响及噪音污染；消防及灭火系统是否符合安全标准；是否制定应急措施并开展消防疏散演练。 此外，检查还将覆盖更加具体的环境及健康指标。曼谷市政府将每月随机抽检一次废水水质，实时监测PM2.5和PM10浓度，每年两次检测冷却塔水雾中是否存在军团菌。 针对数据中心产生的热量影响，相关部门还将监测数据中心热源点及周边社区的温度和湿度，范围覆盖周边500米区域，并规定24小时内的温差不得超过2摄氏度。 对于新数据中心项目，曼谷市政府目前已暂缓相关许可证的审批工作，等待数据中心经营活动政策委员会明确数据中心的定义及具体监管执行标准，预计相关规定将在两周内进一步明确。 与此同时，曼谷各辖区办公室已经完成对全市数据中心所在地的现场检查，截至目前尚未发现造成居民生活困扰或其他明显扰民问题。不过，曼谷市政府表示，仍将持续接受居民反馈，民众可通过Traffy Fondue系统24小时提交投诉，如发现数据中心造成环境或生活影响，可及时向市政府反映。 查察表示，曼谷市政府将继续在现行法律授权范围内加强监管，不会对相关问题置之不理。对于居民反映的问题，
title_cn: 曼谷数据中心监管升级，43 家设施接受检查
summary_cn: 曼谷市政府加强数据中心安全监管，已摸排全市 43 家位于普通建筑的数据中心（主要分布在办公楼、银行等），另有 6 家独立式中心。政府暂缓新项目许可审批，制定了涉及建筑安全、资源使用、环保、消防和应急疏散等 5 大领域的检查标准。数据中心用电占全市最高用电量不足 3%，政府承诺每月随机检查废水、监测空气质量和温度变化，并接受居民投诉。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 近日，曼谷市政府加大对数据中心的安全监管力度，目前已完成对全市数据中心的初步摸排，并针对建筑安全、资源使用、环境影响、消防安全及应急疏散等5大领域制定检查标准。同时，曼谷市政府已暂缓新数据中心项目相关许可证的审批，等待相关政策委员会进一步明确相关定义及执行标准。 9月14日，曼谷市长查察主持召开新闻发布会，公布曼谷市内数据中心检查工作的最新进展。查察表示，目前曼谷共有43家位于普通建筑物内的数据中心，主要分布在办公楼、银行及政府机构等场所，其中大多数规模较小，用电量不超过2兆瓦，且已运营多年。 此外，曼谷还有6家独立式数据中心，其中3家已经投入运营，另外3家仍处于建设阶段。目前，曼谷市政府已暂缓审查这3个在建项目的相关许可证。 在燃油储存方面，43家数据中心中有31家使用小型发电机，因储油量未达到相关标准，无需申请燃油储存许可证；另有12家数据中心的燃油储存量超过1.5万升，均已依法向能源部门申请相关许可证。 查察指出，曼谷的数据中心目前并不属于用电规模达到200至300兆瓦的超大规模数据中心。现阶段，曼谷所有数据中心的用电量合计占全市最高用电量的比例不到3%，用水量也低于大型购物中心。 在监管方面，曼谷市政府主要依据建筑施工及改建许可证、城市规划法规和公共卫生相关法律开展监管，同时与曼谷电力局、曼谷供水局、能源厅、工业厅及自然资源与环境政策规划办公室等相关机构合作，强化数据中心的综合监管。 为进一步保障周边居民及环境安全，曼谷市政府已制定5大领域检查清单，将持续对数据中心进行随机检查。 检查内容包括建筑物是否符合相关国际标准；燃油储存及水电使用是否符合有关部门规定；是否存在水污染、空气污染、健康风险、热影响及噪音污染；消防及灭火系统是否符合安全标准；是否制定应急措施并开展消防疏散演练。 此外，检查还将覆盖更加具体的环境及健康指标。曼谷市政府将每月随机抽检一次废水水质，实时监测PM2.5和PM10浓度，每年两次检测冷却塔水雾中是否存在军团菌。 针对数据中心产生的热量影响，相关部门还将监测数据中心热源点及周边社区的温度和湿度，范围覆盖周边500米区域，并规定24小时内的温差不得超过2摄氏度。 对于新数据中心项目，曼谷市政府目前已暂缓相关许可证的审批工作，等待数据中心经营活动政策委员会明确数据中心的定义及具体监管执行标准，预计相关规定将在两周内进一步明确。 与此同时，曼谷各辖区办公室已经完成对全市数据中心所在地的现场检查，截至目前尚未发现造成居民生活困扰或其他明显扰民问题。不过，曼谷市政府表示，仍将持续接受居民反馈，民众可通过Traffy Fondue系统24小时提交投诉，如发现数据中心造成环境或生活影响，可及时向市政府反映。 查察表示，曼谷市政府将继续在现行法律授权范围内加强监管，不会对相关问题置之不理。对于居民反映的问题，

title: Udon Thani student seeks help after losing baby in lone dorm birth
desc: Udon Thani student seeks help after losing baby in lone dorm birth Legacy A Udon Thani student is receiving medical care after giving birth alone in her dormitory and losing her premature baby , with police awaiting forensic results to establish the exact circumstances of the infant’s death. The fourth-year university student was believed to be around seven months pregnant when she unexpectedly went into labour during the night of September 12. She delivered her baby alone in her room without medical assistance. Reports said the baby was born prematurely and was physically weak before dying some time after the birth. Police have since sent the infant for a forensic examination to establish the exact cause of death. The young woman had reportedly separated from the baby’s father during her pregnancy and had decided to continue the pregnancy and care for the child herself while completing her studies. She continued attending university throughout the pregnancy. After losing her baby, the student was reportedly distressed and unsure where to seek help. Reports said she placed her baby in a suitcase and went to a nearby temple seeking assistance with funeral arrangements. Monks advised

Critics had also accused the ministry of surrendering economic sovereignty, hurting Thai SMEs and leaving no safeguard against nominee companies. title: Thai flight attendant heroin case adjourned to October 12
desc: Thai flight attendant heroin case adjourned to October 12 Legacy A Thai flight attendant accused of carrying more than one kilogramme of heroin into Australia will remain in custody after her Melbourne court case was adjourned . Thai investigators say she had been hired to carry the bags and have not established whether she knew drugs were concealed inside them. The 26 year old flight attendant reportedly accepted the courier job through a Facebook group after an account using the name Rose Rose sought someone travelling to Australia to carry what was presented as OTOP products and clothing. She was later given 12 elephant-pattern tote bags to take to Melbourne. Thai investigators have said they are still unable to determine whether she knew the bags contained heroin. Earlier inquiries found no illegal items during a search of her Bangkok condominium, while investigators continued tracing suspects who allegedly arranged and delivered the shipment. title: 中国“红通”男子潜逃36年，冒用身份在泰敛财近亿
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 近日，泰国警方联合内政部行政厅、移民警察及地方行政部门在春武里府芭提雅抓获一名67岁中国籍男子，其涉嫌冒用他人身份取得泰国身份证并在芭提雅经营综合旅游业务超过30年。警方目前已查扣其在泰土地、车辆及其他资产，总价值约8950万泰铢，后续将依法处理其泰国国籍及遣返事宜。 9月13日下午1时，泰国国家警察总署副署长萨兰警上将、内政部行政厅厅长纳鲁查以及第二警区、春武里府警察局、移民警察、旅游警察、地方行政部门等多部门负责人联合公布案件进展。 警方依据芭提雅府法院2026年第509号逮捕令，以涉嫌向公务人员提供虚假信息、出示虚假证据办理身份证等罪名，对67岁的中国籍男子“苏查·苏拉猜”实施抓捕。警方于9月12日晚在春武里府邦拉蒙县农普鲁镇一处住宅内将其逮捕。 调查发现，该男子原名朱志山（Mr. Zhu Zhishan），36年前在中国浙江省台州市因涉故意杀人被中国警方通缉，2020年国际刑警组织对其发布红色通缉令。警方称，该案件目前尚未超过追诉时效，泰方正进一步收集相关证据，与中国有关部门协调，依法推进后续司法程序，最终将其送回中国接受案件处理。 据调查，朱志山涉嫌在案发后逃离中国，先前往缅甸，随后越境进入泰国。2001年，朱志山涉嫌冒用一名克伦族人士的身份，在达府帕蓬县办理泰国身份证。据警方掌握的信息，其当时疑似支付约5万泰铢办理相关手续，随后取得一张登记姓名为“苏查·苏拉猜”的泰国身份证。 取得身份证后，朱志山迁往春武里府邦拉蒙县生活，并开始在芭提雅从事旅游相关业务。警方调查发现，他与5家公司存在关联，业务涵盖旅游业多个领域，包括酒店、餐厅、咖啡店以及其他旅游相关业务，形成综合旅游经营模式。相关公司注册资本总额约8900万泰铢，其在芭提雅经营旅游业务的时间已超过30年。 调查还发现，朱志山在泰国生活期间，于1990年11月12日在邦拉蒙县与一名名为任云华（Mrs. Ren Yunhua）的女子登记结婚，之后育有一对龙凤胎，目前均为12岁。两名子女此前通过办理出生登记取得泰国国籍。有关部门目前正进一步调查两名子女及其他相关人员的身份和国籍取得过程。 户籍资料显示，在过去13年间，朱志山曾8次迁移户籍登记。2003年，他从达府帕蓬县的户籍地址迁出，迁入春武里府邦拉蒙县，此后又在邦拉蒙县境内7次迁移户籍。其最近一次登记迁入的地址为春武里府邦拉蒙县农普鲁镇9组223/36号，登记日期为2016年4月22日，该地址同时也是其目前泰国身份证上登记的住址。 此次案件的调查源于朱志山此前持泰国身份相关文件办理手续并前往中国。中国有关部门在核查其资料时发现异常。朱志山此前为中国公民，却又取得泰国国籍，中方进一步调查后发现，“苏查·苏拉猜”实际上就是朱志山，涉嫌故意杀人后外逃。随后，中国驻泰使馆向泰国内政部通报相关情况，要求泰方紧急调查。 泰国
title_cn: 被国际通缉36年的中国逃犯在泰芭提雅落网
summary_cn: 67岁中国籍男子朱志山因涉嫌故意杀人于36年前被浙江台州警方通缉，国际刑警组织2020年对其发布红色通缉令。朱志山先后逃往缅甸和泰国，2001年冒用克伦族身份在泰国办理身份证（苏查·苏拉猜），之后在春武里府芭提雅经营旅游业务超30年，涉及5家公司、资产总值约8950万泰铢。9月12日，泰国警方在邦拉蒙县将其逮捕，现正与中国部门协调推进遣返和司法程序。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 近日，泰国警方联合内政部行政厅、移民警察及地方行政部门在春武里府芭提雅抓获一名67岁中国籍男子，其涉嫌冒用他人身份取得泰国身份证并在芭提雅经营综合旅游业务超过30年。警方目前已查扣其在泰土地、车辆及其他资产，总价值约8950万泰铢，后续将依法处理其泰国国籍及遣返事宜。 9月13日下午1时，泰国国家警察总署副署长萨兰警上将、内政部行政厅厅长纳鲁查以及第二警区、春武里府警察局、移民警察、旅游警察、地方行政部门等多部门负责人联合公布案件进展。 警方依据芭提雅府法院2026年第509号逮捕令，以涉嫌向公务人员提供虚假信息、出示虚假证据办理身份证等罪名，对67岁的中国籍男子“苏查·苏拉猜”实施抓捕。警方于9月12日晚在春武里府邦拉蒙县农普鲁镇一处住宅内将其逮捕。 调查发现，该男子原名朱志山（Mr. Zhu Zhishan），36年前在中国浙江省台州市因涉故意杀人被中国警方通缉，2020年国际刑警组织对其发布红色通缉令。警方称，该案件目前尚未超过追诉时效，泰方正进一步收集相关证据，与中国有关部门协调，依法推进后续司法程序，最终将其送回中国接受案件处理。 据调查，朱志山涉嫌在案发后逃离中国，先前往缅甸，随后越境进入泰国。2001年，朱志山涉嫌冒用一名克伦族人士的身份，在达府帕蓬县办理泰国身份证。据警方掌握的信息，其当时疑似支付约5万泰铢办理相关手续，随后取得一张登记姓名为“苏查·苏拉猜”的泰国身份证。 取得身份证后，朱志山迁往春武里府邦拉蒙县生活，并开始在芭提雅从事旅游相关业务。警方调查发现，他与5家公司存在关联，业务涵盖旅游业多个领域，包括酒店、餐厅、咖啡店以及其他旅游相关业务，形成综合旅游经营模式。相关公司注册资本总额约8900万泰铢，其在芭提雅经营旅游业务的时间已超过30年。 调查还发现，朱志山在泰国生活期间，于1990年11月12日在邦拉蒙县与一名名为任云华（Mrs. Ren Yunhua）的女子登记结婚，之后育有一对龙凤胎，目前均为12岁。两名子女此前通过办理出生登记取得泰国国籍。有关部门目前正进一步调查两名子女及其他相关人员的身份和国籍取得过程。 户籍资料显示，在过去13年间，朱志山曾8次迁移户籍登记。2003年，他从达府帕蓬县的户籍地址迁出，迁入春武里府邦拉蒙县，此后又在邦拉蒙县境内7次迁移户籍。其最近一次登记迁入的地址为春武里府邦拉蒙县农普鲁镇9组223/36号，登记日期为2016年4月22日，该地址同时也是其目前泰国身份证上登记的住址。 此次案件的调查源于朱志山此前持泰国身份相关文件办理手续并前往中国。中国有关部门在核查其资料时发现异常。朱志山此前为中国公民，却又取得泰国国籍，中方进一步调查后发现，“苏查·苏拉猜”实际上就是朱志山，涉嫌故意杀人后外逃。随后，中国驻泰使馆向泰国内政部通报相关情况，要求泰方紧急调查。 泰国
